title: An item arrives in the middle of a turn

steps.why: A three-step turn the fleet started, so you are not engaged with the coder: model calls at 0, 2 and 4 minutes, final reply at 6

steps.summary: Review comments are in on the health check
steps.why: Past the batch window at 100 s, while the coder is between its first and second steps

expect.name: not-between-steps
expect.why: Queue, not steer: the item never reaches a model call inside the running turn

expect.name: after-the-reply
expect.why: It runs once the turn's final reply is written, in the same busy span
